# cidaas_federation_provider (Data Source)

The data source `cidaas_federation_provider` looks up a single federated identity provider on cidaas v4 (Trustdesk) by `id` or `provider_name` and exposes the same attributes as the `cidaas_federation_provider` resource. Secrets are marked sensitive and are null when the API does not return them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a federation provider by its unique provider_name ...
data "cidaas_federation_provider" "google" {
  provider_name = "default_google"
}

# ... or by id.
data "cidaas_federation_provider" "by_id" {
  id = "3f453233-92d4-475b-b10e-813fbd476c50"
}

output "google_client_id" {
  value = data.cidaas_federation_provider.google.oauth2.client_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the federation provider. Exactly one of `id` or `provider_name` must be set.
- `provider_name` (String) Unique provider name. Exactly one of `id` or `provider_name` must be set; the name must match exactly one provider.

### Read-Only

- `attribute_mapping` (Attributes Map) Attribute mapping from the external provider to cidaas fields. The map key must equal `field_key`: a system field (e.g. `email`, `given_name`), `customFields.<key>` or `identityCustomFields.<key>`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_mapping))
- `created_time` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description of the provider.
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the UI. Required when `standard_type` is `SAML`.
- `domains` (List of String) Allowed domains for this provider.
- `enabled_for_admin_portal` (Boolean) Whether the provider is available for the admin portal login.
- `ldap` (Attributes) LDAP configuration. Required when `standard_type` is `LDAP`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ldap))
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the provider logo.
- `oauth2` (Attributes) OAuth2 / OpenID Connect configuration. Required when `standard_type` is `OAUTH2` or `OPENID_CONNECT`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth2))
- `owner` (String) Owner of the provider. One of `admin`, `client`, `core`, `system`. Defaults to `client` (visible in the Admin UI).
- `provider_type` (String) Platform of the provider (API field `provider`; `provider` itself is a reserved Terraform meta-argument): a catalog social key (`amazon`, `apple`, `discord`, `facebook`, `foursquare`, `github`, `gitlab`, `google`, `instagram`, `linkedin`, `microsoft`, `netid`, `netid_qa`, `officeenterprise`, `paypal`, `paypal_sandbox`, `salesforce`, `slack`, `tiktok`, `twitter`, `wordpress`, `x`, `yahoo`, `yammer`) or `custom`. Catalog social providers do not need endpoint URLs or `userinfo_source`.
- `saml` (Attributes) SAML configuration. Required when `standard_type` is `SAML`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml))
- `standard_type` (String) Protocol of the provider. One of `OAUTH2`, `OPENID_CONNECT`, `SAML`, `LDAP`.
- `updated_time` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_mapping`

Read-Only:

- `data_type` (String) Data type. Required for SAML. OAuth2/OIDC: `string`, `integer`, `boolean`, `dateTime`. SAML additionally: `xsd:string`, `xsd:integer`, `xsd:boolean`, `xsd:dateTime`, `xsd:base64Binary`, `saml:NameID`.
- `default` (String) Default value used when the external attribute is missing.
- `email_verified_key` (String) External attribute holding the email-verified flag (legacy AD migration).
- `external_key` (String) Attribute name on the external provider (claim name or SAML attribute).
- `field_key` (String) Canonical cidaas field. Must equal the map key.
- `ignore` (Boolean) Do not map this attribute. Defaults to `false`.
- `transform` (Attributes) Optional value transformation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_mapping--transform))

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_mapping--transform"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_mapping.transform`

Read-Only:

- `config` (Map of String) Transformation specific configuration.
- `type` (String) Transformation type (e.g. `regex`, `format`, `function`).



<a id="nestedatt--ldap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ldap`

Read-Only:

- `base_dn` (String) Base DN. At least one of `base_dn` or `search_base` is required.
- `bind_credentials` (String, Sensitive) Bind password. Stored in state; conflicts with `bind_credentials_wo`.
- `bind_dn` (String) DN used to bind to the directory.
- `connection_string` (String) LDAP URL (`ldap://` or `ldaps://`). At least one of `connection_string` or `host` is required.
- `default_groups` (Attributes List) Groups (and roles) assigned to users from this directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ldap--default_groups))
- `filter` (String) Search filter.
- `host` (String) LDAP host. At least one of `connection_string` or `host` is required.
- `port` (Number) LDAP port (1-65535).
- `search_base` (String) Search base. At least one of `base_dn` or `search_base` is required.
- `unique_field` (String) Attribute that uniquely identifies a user.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Use SSL/TLS.
- `user_filter` (String) User filter.
- `user_sync` (Boolean) Synchronize users.

<a id="nestedatt--ldap--default_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ldap.default_groups`

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (String) Group ID.
- `roles` (List of String) Roles within the group.



<a id="nestedatt--oauth2"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth2`

Read-Only:

- `amr_config` (Attributes List) Mapping between external and cidaas AMR values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth2--amr_config))
- `authorization_endpoint` (String) Authorization endpoint (https). Required for custom providers unless `wellknown_endpoint` is set; optional override for catalog social providers.
- `authorization_parameters` (Map of String) Additional query parameters appended to the authorization request.
- `claims` (Attributes) Claims required or optionally read from the provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth2--claims))
- `client_id` (String) Client ID issued by the external provider.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret. Stored in state. Required unless `pkce` is `true`; conflicts with `client_secret_wo`.
- `groups` (String) Provider specific group attribute / location.
- `pkce` (Boolean) Use PKCE for the authorization code flow. When `true`, no client secret is required. Defaults to `false`.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes requested from the provider.
- `scopes_config` (Attributes) Full scope configuration (label and per-scope flags). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth2--scopes_config))
- `token_endpoint` (String) Token endpoint (https). Required for custom providers unless `wellknown_endpoint` is set.
- `token_endpoint_auth` (String, Sensitive) Authentication used when calling the token endpoint, as JSON (`jsonencode({ apiAccessType = "...", ... })`).
- `userinfo_endpoint` (String) Userinfo endpoint (https). Required for custom providers without `wellknown_endpoint` when `userinfo_source` is `USERINFOENDPOINT`.
- `userinfo_source` (String) Where user claims are read from: `USERINFOENDPOINT`, `IDTOKEN` or `ACCESSTOKEN`. Required for custom providers.
- `wellknown_endpoint` (String) OIDC discovery URL (https). Alternative to `authorization_endpoint` + `token_endpoint`. The API does not persist it; the configured value is kept in state.

<a id="nestedatt--oauth2--amr_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth2.amr_config`

Read-Only:

- `amr_value` (String) cidaas AMR value.
- `ext_amr_value` (String) External AMR value.


<a id="nestedatt--oauth2--claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth2.claims`

Read-Only:

- `optional_claims` (Attributes) Claims mapped when present. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth2--claims--optional_claims))
- `required_claims` (Attributes) Claims that must be present. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oauth2--claims--required_claims))

Read-Only:

- `user_info` (List of String) Claim names read from the userinfo response.


<a id="nestedatt--oauth2--claims--required_claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth2.claims.required_claims`

Read-Only:

- `id_token` (List of String) Claim names read from the ID token.
- `user_info` (List of String) Claim names read from the userinfo response.

### Nested Schema for `oauth2.scopes_config`

Read-Only:

### Nested Schema for `oauth2.scopes_config.scopes`

Read-Only:

- `recommended` (Boolean) Whether the scope is recommended. Defaults to `false`.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the scope is required. Defaults to `false`.
- `scope_name` (String) Scope name (e.g. `email`).




<a id="nestedatt--saml"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml`

Read-Only:

- `encryption_config` (Attributes) Encryption of SAML messages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--encryption_config))
- `idp_initiated_config` (Attributes) IdP-initiated login configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--idp_initiated_config))
- `meta_data` (String) IdP metadata XML.
- `protocol_binding_method` (String) Protocol binding method of the authentication request.

- `sp_signing_certificates` (Attributes List) SP signing certificates generated by cidaas (read-only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml--sp_signing_certificates))
- `user_id_attribute` (String) SAML attribute used as user ID. Defaults to the NameID when unset.

<a id="nestedatt--saml--encryption_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.encryption_config`

Read-Only:

- `content_encryption_algorithm` (String) One of `AES-128-CBC`, `AES-256-CBC`, `AES-128-GCM`, `AES-256-GCM`.
- `encrypt_targets` (List of String) Messages to encrypt when sending: `assertion`.
- `key_transport_algorithm` (String) One of `RSA-OAEP-MGF1P`, `RSA-OAEP-SHA256`.
- `require_encrypted_for` (List of String) Messages that must be encrypted when received: `assertion`.


<a id="nestedatt--saml--idp_initiated_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml.idp_initiated_config`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) Client that receives the IdP-initiated login.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable IdP-initiated login. Defaults to `false`.
- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by the API.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol used (typically `SAML`).

<a id="nestedatt--saml--signature_config"></a>
